notes_for_editor: Only real detail is the Clearwater County survey PDF (owner Mn MFS; the 1938 note is quoted). It gives no build year, height, design or type for Roy Lake, so the 'probably erected' wording is the survey's own estimate. The 'hamlet' is unnamed in the source. Record coordinates (47.2809, -95.47566) match the survey. Record status 'gone' agrees with both sources. The event is 'other' not 'removed' because the survey note of 1938 only shows removal happened before that date.
